issue.title: [HFO-15] Connect approved reminders to the existing audit calendar
issue.description:
Useful reminders should surface due work without duplicate alerts or invented delivery claims.

**Scope**
Reuse COL-32's calendar ownership and approved rule inputs. Implement in-app reminders/escalation acknowledgment with digest/duplicate suppression, backup routing and explicit unknown recipient/window; external SMS/email/voice only under later verified channel activation.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] Known due/overdue rules create one appropriate in-app episode; resolving/reopening tracks the episode correctly.
- [ ] Unknown deadlines/recipients stay configuration-needed and do not send external messages.
- [ ] Acknowledge/snooze/delivery are not completion; only authorized configured channels can claim actual delivery.

**Dependencies:** [COL-137](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-137/hfo-03-implement-one-recurrence-and-due-date-evaluator), [COL-148](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-148/hfo-10-build-the-staff-today-upcoming-and-history-workspace), [COL-144](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-144/hfo-14-track-problems-next-actions-backup-ownership-and-resolution)
**Related existing work:** [COL-32](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-32/audit-reminder-and-escalation-around-the-building-audits)
**Release:** Connected. Implementation not started; this issue is not proof of deployment or staff acceptance.
**Source items:** Shared core contract across all applicable Admin Log items
**Source/code pointers:** `COL-32, OPS-001, R03 R12`. Migration filenames are under `supabase/migrations/`; source paths are relative to Circle-of-Life unless explicitly named otherwise. Reconcile current main before editing.
**Open configuration questions:** Q05, Q29 See [Haven Facility Operations — Source Coverage and Open Decisions](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-source-coverage-and-open-decisions-0bf9ab4bebce).

**Build contract:** [Haven Facility Operations — Build Scope](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-build-scope-fa76df5ada21). **Sequence:** [Haven Facility Operations — Delivery Roadmap](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-delivery-roadmap-eab29aa94849).

One bounded implementation segment at a time. Record exact source/commit, focused behavioral tests, applicable repository segment gates, review and rollback/handoff evidence. Preserve current authority after waits and on retries, existing dirty/concurrent work, source truth and unknown rules. No new dependency, external transmission, clinical/employment decision or policy activation is implied. Keep source/local/hosted/provider/staff/operating-cycle acceptance distinct. No named assignee, estimate or date has been invented.

Roadmap key: HFO-15 / HAVEN-ADMIN-20260909

Jessica Murphy audits all five buildings and owns the compliance calendar. The ask from the 2026-09-03 meeting: reminder and escalation windows around every audit so nothing hits a deadline unflagged.

nodes.title: Validate the Homewood referral-to-move-in baseline and bottlenecks
nodes.description:
Agent-created plan — not human acknowledgement. September 11, 2026.

## Outcome

Produce an operator-validated Homewood referral-to-move-in baseline and ranked list of evidenced bottlenecks, using the source/analysis contract from COL-35. This is measurement and workflow discovery, not a feature build.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Declare a recent period (initially 30–60 days if evidence permits), channel coverage, facility population, unique case/episode definitions, missing data, unresolved outcomes, and limitations. A sample must not be presented as the full conversion denominator.
- [ ] Review representative won, declined, stalled, after-hours, return, and cross-facility cases where available with the appointed reviewers. Distinguish verified absence from missing capture, and record unavailable categories as evidence limitations. Separate first receipt, owner acknowledgment, substantive response, review, financial/documentation readiness, and actual arrival; measure staff work separately from elapsed waiting.
- [ ] Identify evidenced constraints: missed capture/coverage, resident preference, appropriate usable rooms, staffing/equipment/services, financial or paperwork dependencies, family explanations, and receiving-team/early-residency commitments. A refusal of another location is not automatically recoverable demand.
- [ ] Reuse confirmed definitions and existing records. Current AR means monthly rent roll; promised funds, deposits, collections, contribution, and census are distinct. Do not fabricate unknown reasons or prices, infer diagnoses, or make placement decisions.
- [ ] Deliver a ranked constraint list with counts, evidence strength, limitations, relevant quality/workload measures, and a recommended measurable outcome. Record reviewer's role, date, and substantive validation; recorded data alone is not acknowledgment.
- [ ] Publish only non-identifying aggregates and findings in Linear. Maintain authorized source evidence in its approved location. No external messages, vendor trials, application edits, or data imports are authorized by this issue.

## Dependencies and next actor

Blocked by COL-35 and [COL-178](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-178/name-the-col-admissions-improvement-owner-and-homewood-baseline). Planned technical analyst: Codex; operating validation uses the appointed people. Keep human assignee empty until an actual human action is next, and retain separate Decision issues for approvals. Start only when source coverage and the owner/reviewer appointment support this work.

## Evidence and rollback

Record source versions, cohort/period, actor/validation, limitations, and the next intervention-comparison issue. Record any process changes during observation so before/after differences are not falsely attributed to software. No production change, ROI, clinical acceptance, or release is implied.

Existing implementation context: COL-155, COL-157, COL-166, COL-168. Their scope and priority are preserved. Roadmap: [COL admissions improvement — discovery, decisions, and investment criteria](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/col-admissions-improvement-discovery-decisions-and-investment-criteria-f775b2b7631a)

nodes.title: Clear the Supabase Security Advisor findings before Homewood goes live
nodes.description:
Security Advisor run against project `manfqmasfqppukpobpld` on 2026-09-04. Every fix ships as a migration in the repository under `supabase/migrations/`, never by hand in the dashboard. Build authority is the repo.

**Errors (2)**

* View `public.quality_latest_facility_measures` is SECURITY DEFINER. Recreate with `security_invoker = true` (`CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ... WITH (security_invoker = true)`), or move it to a non-exposed schema.
* View `public.resident_billable_status` is SECURITY DEFINER. Same fix. This one reads resident data, so it is the first to fix.

**Warnings: SECURITY DEFINER functions callable by the** `authenticated` **role over** `/rest/v1/rpc/` **(14)**
Decide per function: keep SECURITY DEFINER and `REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION ... FROM authenticated, anon;` (then call it only from Edge Functions with the service role), or switch to `SECURITY INVOKER` and let RLS do the work.

* `public.allocate_incident_number(uuid)`
* `public.allocate_vendor_po_number(uuid)`
* `public.apply_col_discovery_round_observation_plan(uuid)`
* `public.apply_plantation_wing_observation_plan(uuid)`
* `public.delete_nlq_thread(uuid)`
* `public.execute_compliance_rule(uuid, uuid)`
* `public.get_compliance_rule_status(uuid, uuid)`
* `public.grace_top_flows(uuid)`
* `public.haven_create_invoice_with_line_items(...)`
* `public.haven_publish_rate_schedule(...)`
* `public.haven_replace_active_resident_rate_agreement(...)`
* `public.rename_nlq_thread(uuid, text)`
* `public.search_nlq_threads(text, integer)`
* `public.set_nlq_message_feedback(uuid, text)`, `public.set_nlq_thread_archived(uuid, boolean)`, `public.set_nlq_thread_pinned(uuid, boolean)`

**Warnings: mutable search_path (12)**
Add `SET search_path = ''` (or the explicit schema list) to each: `public.haven_csc_discrepancy_defaults`, `public.document_role_can_view_audience`, `haven.role_tier`, `haven.can_manage_user`, `public.auto_trigger_watch_protocol`, `public.seed_admission_case_form_1823`, `public._ai_tool_role_allowed`, `public.haven_exec_nlq_messages_touch_session`, `public.increment_usage`, `public.normalize_alias_term`, `public._kb_seed_targets_touch`, `public.apply_invoice_payment`.

**Warnings: extensions in** `public` **(3)**
`vector`, `pg_trgm`, `btree_gist`. Create schema `extensions` if missing and `ALTER EXTENSION ... SET SCHEMA extensions;` then fix any unqualified references.

**Warning: Auth**
Leaked password protection is off. Turn on in Authentication > Providers > Email (HaveIBeenPwned check). Dashboard setting, no migration.

**Info (2)**
RLS enabled with no policies on `public.reputation_google_oauth_credentials` and `public.vendor_po_sequences`. Either intentional (service role only, document it) or add policies.

**Exit criteria**: Security Advisor shows zero errors and zero warnings with High Compliance enabled ([COL-5](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-5/enable-the-supabase-hipaa-add-on-and-execute-the-baa)). Re-run `get_advisors` after each migration batch.

No resident data appears in this issue; object names only.

nodes.title: HIPAA training for Brian and management before Homewood Lodge goes live on Haven
nodes.description:
Workforce training is required under 45 CFR 164.530(b) for anyone whose work touches PHI, paid or not. Brian is workforce under the W-2 letter and will hold admin access to every resident record in Haven. Nobody can be handed a Haven login before their training is on file.

Scope:

* Brian: full privacy and security rule training, documented with date and content.
* Management: Darren, Michelle, Jessica Murphy, the five administrators.
* Homewood Lodge floor staff: covered inside the on-site Haven training ([COL-20](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-20/homewood-lodge-staff-training-on-site-every-shift)), with the HIPAA module recorded separately.

Deliverables:

* Training record per person (name, date, content, who delivered it), stored in the Notion People database, never in Haven and never in this issue.
* The training deck and the acknowledgment form filed under Compliance & Standards in Notion.
* Confirm with Jessica Murphy whether COL already has a HIPAA training program and who the designated Privacy Officer and Security Officer are today. If nobody is named, that is a Darren Decision.

Blocks Homewood go-live.
